name: energyiq
description: EnergyIQ AI-powered energy intelligence SaaS platform.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm --workspace @energyiq/frontend run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace @energyiq/shared run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/service-kit run build
scripts.build:services: npm --workspace @energyiq/api-gateway run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/auth-service run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/organization-service run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/device-service run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/analytics-service run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/forecast-service run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/notification-service run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:packages && npm run typecheck:services && npm --workspace @energyiq/frontend run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm --workspace @energyiq/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/shared run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/service-kit run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/service-kit run build && npm --workspace @energyiq/database run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:services: npm --workspace @energyiq/api-gateway run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/auth-service run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/organization-service run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/device-service run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/analytics-service run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/forecast-service run typecheck && npm --workspace @energyiq/notification-service run typecheck
